ana: Quick Q — where's the canonical dashboard for GPU SM% + KV cache hitrate per region? Trying to tune Dedicated autoscale for EU vs US. Anyone?

mohit: There's a gpu-overview dashboard that has SM% + kvcache panels and a region variable. Use that as the single source of truth. Link: https://grafana.internal/d/gpu-overview?orgId=1

sara: Also useful: a throughput-by-pool dashboard that shows batch size vs latency per pool (super helpful when deciding autoscale vs batch tweaks). https://grafana.internal/d/srv-gpu/throughput-by-pool?orgId=1

mohit: For traces, use Tempo via the grafana "traces" action on a slow request panel or direct: https://tempo.internal/trace/<trace_id>. For logs, Loki queries live in grafana. Example Loki query I use to find kvcache eviction spikes:```
{job="redwood-runtime"} |= "kvcache.eviction" | json | line_format "{{.ts}} {{.pool}} evictions={{.evictions}}"
```

tj: If you're tuning alerts: consider increasing the gpu SM% threshold to 94% with a 10m fordown cooldown for beamish-prod. We get too many 1–2min flaps at 90. Also add an alert that combines kvcache_mem_pct > 80% AND kvcache_hitrate < 70% so we don't fire on warmup-only.

ana: Where's the prometheus rule for SM%? I want to open a PR to tune it.

mohit: Alert rules live in infra repo under prometheus/rules/gpu_rules.yaml. PR should include: rationale, historical noise sample (last 30d), and intended cooldown/threshold.

sara: I can open the PR. Which clusters should we target? EU-prod + us-west-prod please.

mohit: Also check kvcache memory graph. If kvcache_mem_pct > 80% AND kvcache_hitrate < 70% then batching is likely wrong. Quick test command for batch sizing:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-internal/v1/test-batch -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","batch":8,"seq":1024}'
```

ana: Can someone paste the direct dashboard link with region set to EU (so I can pin it in docs)?

sara: Pinned link: https://grafana.internal/d/gpu-overview?orgId=1&var-region=eu

ops-bot: Reminder: changes to prometheus rules require code review + staging deploy. :robot_face:

ana: I'll run the batch=8 test and post raw numbers here tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone! :pray:
